scenes.headline: Find musicians, teachers & session players
scenes.subline: Real clips. Local scenes. Remote studio work.
scenes.narration: Welcome to AreaJam — the free web platform built around real performance clips so you can find local bandmates, music teachers, and remote session players.

scenes.headline: Explore your local music scene instantly
scenes.narration: Start in Find a Musician to browse local players in your metro. Filter by instrument or genre, hear their clips, and browse completely free with no account required.

scenes.headline: Local teachers with transparent pricing
scenes.subline: Hear how they play before you book
scenes.narration: Switch to Find a Teacher to discover working musicians offering lessons nearby—with hourly rates displayed cleanly right on their profile card.

scenes.headline: Include remote-friendly pros from any city
scenes.subline: Local first — remote studio tracking right after
scenes.narration: Need studio stems or production? Open Find a Session Player and toggle Include remote-friendly to unlock remote studio pros sorted neatly after local players.

scenes.headline: Clips, pricing, gear locker & followers
scenes.subline: Everything you need to vet the vibe
scenes.narration: Every musician gets a clean, shareable page featuring their performance clips, lessons and session pricing, full gear locker, and public followers list.

scenes.headline: Follow, Jam, Session or Lesson — your call
scenes.narration: When you tap Connect, choose exactly how you want to reach out: a one-tap Follow to bookmark them, or a direct Jam, Session, or Lesson request.

scenes.headline: Build your profile straight from YouTube
scenes.subline: Paste your @handle to pull up to 4 clips
scenes.narration: Ready to join? Open Profile and Studio, type your YouTube handle to import your performance videos and Shorts, and auto-fill your artist details in seconds.

scenes.headline: Add free Teacher, Session & Remote badges
scenes.narration: In Step two, pick your instruments and genres, then optionally toggle Session Player, Teacher, or Remote-friendly with your own rates—100% free.

scenes.headline: Preview your card and publish live
scenes.narration: Check your live preview card with all your badges and pricing in Step three, sign in with Google or Apple, and publish straight to your local scene.

scenes.headline: Find your tribe. Match with musicians today.
scenes.narration: Head to areajam dot com right now to explore your local music scene and build your profile in under a minute.
